page.overview:
What is Kyneth?

Kyneth is known from the Planechase 2012 plane card The Zephyr Maze. This depicts an organically formed island covered with trees. The stone elements of the island wind back and forth and spew forth waterfalls. The island and the maze are best approachable by flying creatures, riding the gentle breeze.
